name: AirWatch — API on RapidAPI
description:
Air quality answers your users can act on: AirWatch returns the current air quality index with a plain-language severity level, multi-day forecasts and pollen data for any location.

What you get:
- Current AQI as a number plus a severity level in words, so widgets and alerts need no interpretation tables
- Pollutant-level detail behind the index, for health and outdoor-activity products
- Multi-day air quality forecasts in one response, for planning views and proactive notifications
- Pollen data alongside air quality, for allergy-aware apps and seasonal content

Key endpoints:
- GET /current — current air quality for a location
- GET /forecast — multi-day air quality forecast in one call
- GET /pollen — current pollen levels for a location

Batch / built for workflows:
AirWatch is forecast-shaped: one /forecast call returns the days ahead as a set, which suits scheduled notification jobs ("tomorrow's air will be poor"), travel and relocation content, and location dashboards that refresh on a timer. Data comes from the Open-Meteo air quality service (CAMS), and every response pairs raw values with the derived severity judgement.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
